emotion-sequences.alt: Three rows, each starting from the same event, a dog running at you. Row 1, arousal first, then the feeling: the body becomes aroused (heart pounds, you tremble), you notice the arousal and feel fear. Row 2, arousal and feeling at the same time: the brain signals body arousal and the feeling of fear at once, and neither causes the other. Row 3, arousal plus a cognitive appraisal, then the feeling: the body is aroused, you label the arousal as "this dog is dangerous", and then you feel fear.
